name: ca65-vscode-extension
description: ca65 Assembly language support for VS Code
author: Quang Luong

ca65.executablePath.description: Path to the ca65 compiler executable. If unset, ca65 is resolved from PATH.

ca65.fileExtensions.description: File extensions indexed and watched by the ca65 language server.

enumDescriptions: Auto: the CPU implied by `ca65.cc65.target` (6502 for most targets, including the default c64 and nes; 65C02 for apple2enh, cx16, geos-apple, sim65c02, and pce; 65SC02 for lynx and supervision)
CMOS 65SC02 (Atari Lynx, early Apple IIc; no bit ops or WAI/STP)
Full WDC 65C02S with Rockwell bit ops plus WAI/STP (Commander X16; requires cc65 2.19+)
ca65.cpu.description: Target CPU architecture used for instruction hovers, completions, timing/size estimates, reference guide, and `ca65 --cpu` diagnostics. `auto` (default) uses the CPU implied by `ca65.cc65.target`; an explicit CPU overrides it everywhere, including cc65 C mode.

ca65.includeDirs.description: Workspace-relative (or glob) paths to search for `.include` statements after the current file's directory.

ca65.binIncludeDirs.description: Workspace-relative (or glob) paths to search for `.incbin` statements after the current file's directory.

ca65.implicitImports.description: Treats undefined symbols as imports without requiring explicit `.import` declarations (`ca65 --auto-import`).

ca65.cComments.description: Enables `--feature c_comments` for C-style block comments (`/* ... */`) when supported by ca65.

ca65.lineContinuations.description: Enables `--feature line_continuations` for backslash (`\`) line continuations when supported by ca65.

ca65.additionalArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to ca65 (e.g. `"-D"`, `"DEBUG=1"`, `"-s"`). Output flags (`-o`, `-l`, `--listing`, `--create-dep`, `--create-full-dep`) are ignored.

ca65.enableStderrDiagnostics.description: Enables diagnostics powered by ca65 stderr.

ca65.anonymousLabelIndexHints.description: Enables inlay hints for anonymous label indexes.

ca65.importFromHints.description: Enables inlay hints to display the origin file of an import.

ca65.enableStatusBarCycleCount.description: Shows estimated cycle count and byte size for the selected instructions (or current line) in the status bar.

ca65.enableStatusBarSegment.description: Shows the active ca65 segment for the current cursor line in the status bar.

ca65.smartFolding.description: Enables smart folding based on scopes, procs, and other blocks. Disable to use the editor's default folding.

ca65.autoIncludeExtensions.description: A list of extensions for which we will provide auto-include candidates.

ca65.enableInstructionHover.description: Enables hovercards for CPU instruction mnemonics.

ca65.enableDirectiveHover.description: Enables hovercards for ca65 assembler directives.

enumDescriptions: A `/** ... */` block above the definition (as Markdown) if there is one, otherwise the `;` comments directly above it and the trailing `;` comment on its line (verbatim, split by a divider).
Only `/** ... */` blocks above the definition, rendered as Markdown. Requires `#ca65.cComments#`.
ca65.hoverDocs.markdownDescription: Which comments are shown as a symbol's documentation in hovers, completion details, and signature help.

ca65.linkerConfig.description: Path to an ld65 linker configuration (.cfg) file (absolute or workspace-relative) used for `.segment` completions, hover details, go-to-definition, segment type resolution, and unknown-segment warnings.

ca65.enableCSupport.markdownDescription: (Work in progress) **cc65 C mode**: C support for mixed C/assembly cc65 projects. Runs clangd for the workspace's C files (configured for the cc65 dialect) and links C and assembly symbols (`foo` in C ↔ `_foo` in assembly), with cc65 diagnostics, inline assembly support, and the generated assembly view. Requires clangd (and cc65 for diagnostics and the assembly view). If you use another C extension (clangd, C/C++), disable it for cc65 workspaces, or C files will get results from both.

ca65.cc65.executablePath.description: (Work in progress) Path to the cc65 C compiler, used for C diagnostics (instead of clangd's), the generated assembly view, and to locate cc65's headers. If unset, cc65 is resolved from PATH (or next to `ca65.executablePath`).

ca65.cc65.target.description: (Work in progress) cc65 target system (`cc65 -t`) used when compiling C files for diagnostics and the generated assembly view: it selects the target's predefined macros (e.g. `__C64__`, `__NES__`), CPU, and string character set. The target macros are also defined for clangd. Defaults to `c64`, like cc65 without `-t`.

ca65.cc65.additionalArgs.description: (Work in progress) Additional command-line arguments passed to cc65 for C diagnostics and the generated assembly view, e.g. `["-Oirs"]` or `["--code-name", "BANK1"]`, to match your build. Output and dependency-file options are ignored.

ca65.clangd.path.description: (Work in progress) Path to the clangd executable. If unset, clangd is resolved from PATH.

ca65.clangd.arguments.description: (Work in progress) Additional command-line arguments passed to clangd.

ca65.clangd.compileFlags.description: (Work in progress) Additional compiler flags for C files, e.g. target defines such as `"-D__C64__"` or extra include paths. Used in the generated compile database and as clangd's fallback flags.

ca65.clangd.cc65IncludeDir.description: (Work in progress) cc65's C include directory (the one containing cc65's `stdio.h`). If unset, it is located from CC65_INC, CC65_HOME, or the cc65 installation next to the ca65 executable.

ca65.additionalExtensions.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: add extra extensions to `ca65.fileExtensions` instead.
ca65.additionalExtensions.description: Deprecated list of additional extensions indexed alongside `.s`, `.asm`, and `.inc`.

commands.title: ca65: Show Hex & Address Listing Side-by-Side
ca65: Dump Debug Info to Output
ca65: Create Assembly Stub for C Function

scripts.bundle: npm run compile && esbuild client/src/extension.ts --bundle --outfile=client/out/extension.js --external:vscode --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node18 --sourcemap --minify && esbuild server/src/server.ts --bundle --outfile=server/out/server.js --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node18 --sourcemap --minify
